label: Lulu Print API (Lulu Direct) (cross-ref lulu_print_api in Books & media)
terms_note: api_encouraged (separate sandbox account at developers.sandbox.lulu.com; HMAC-signed webhooks, 5 retries then deactivation)

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (client key + secret from the developer portal → https://api.lulu.com/auth/realms/glasstree/protocol/openid-connect/token → Bearer)

auth: 1. Create a Lulu developer account (and a separate sandbox account)
2. Copy client key + secret from the portal
3. Exchange for a Bearer token (client credentials); send `Authorization: Bearer`

endpoints.purpose: quote a book (pod_package_id, page count, quantity, shipping level, address)
shipping levels available for a destination
create + track print jobs (interior + cover PDF URLs)

reference.limits: Not in the spec. - Pay per job; card on file - Sandbox account separate from production

sandbox.notes: Lulu Print API sandbox: 'The sandbox API endpoint URL is https://api.sandbox.lulu.com/' with a separate account at https://developers.sandbox.lulu.com/ and its own client key/secret; print jobs are never produced and can be paid with test cards. The docs show the token path only on the production host (/auth/realms/glasstree/protocol/openid-connect/token); the same path on the documented sandbox host answered the OAuth error invalid_client to a dummy client on 2026-09-27.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client key of your Lulu Print API account (developers.lulu.com > API Keys); sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the client-credentials token request.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret from the same page. Sandbox keys belong to https://api.sandbox.lulu.com, which this server does not switch to.

config_fields.name: contact_email
config_fields.help: contact_email sent with create_order (required by POST /print-jobs/): who Lulu contacts about the Print-Job.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe mints a client-credentials token and reads GET /print-jobs/statistics/ (the number of Print-Jobs in each status).

create_order.note: POST /print-jobs/ creates a Print-Job (201). It 'will remain in an UNPAID state until it is paid for through the developer portal'; with a credit card on file it moves on automatically and 'your card will [be] charged when the Print-Job is sent to production' — so this can SPEND MONEY. `items` are line_items [{title, quantity, printable_normalization: {pod_package_id, cover: {source_url}, interior: {source_url}}} or {printable_id, quantity} for reorders]; `shipping_address` is {name, street1, street2, city, state_code, postcode, country_code, phone_number (required), email}; `shipping_option` is the shipping_level (MAIL, PRIORITY_MAIL, GROUND_HD, GROUND_BUS, GROUND, EXPEDITED, EXPRESS) and is required by Lulu. external_id is a fresh UUID. Costs are decimal strings (total_incl_tax).

get_order.note: GET /print-jobs/{id}/: status.name is CREATED, REJECTED, UNPAID, PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS, PRODUCTION_READY, PRODUCTION_DELAYED, IN_PRODUCTION, ERROR, SHIPPED or CANCELED; costs {total_cost_incl_tax, currency, shipping_cost} are decimal strings; tracking_number is the first line item's status.messages.tracking_id once shipped.

track.note: GET /print-jobs/{id}/status/ — once shipped the status carries line_item_statuses [{name: SHIPPED, messages: {tracking_id, tracking_urls[], carrier_name}, line_item_id}] (one event per line item); before shipping the list is empty.

not_offered.list_products: No product catalogue endpoint: printables are defined per Print-Job by a pod_package_id (trim size, colour, paper, binding) chosen with Lulu's product spec sheet / pricing calculator, not listed through the API.
not_offered.get_product: No product endpoint (see list_products); cover dimensions and file validation endpoints exist but describe files, not products.
not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /shipping-options/ requires line_items[{pod_package_id, page_count, quantity}] and page_count (the book's page count) has no counterpart in the vocabulary's product_id/country/quantity input.

evidence: host api.lulu.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api.lulu.com/api-docs/openapi-specs/openapi_public.yml: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
